catalog.title: Welcome to Agentic Foundry! 🚀
catalog.description: This is your Project Catalog. Here you can browse and manage all of your Foundry-powered development projects.

catalog.title: Global Navigation Menu 🗺️
catalog.description: Use the left sidebar navigation to toggle between your active workspace, project catalogs, and configurations.

catalog.title: Configure Settings 🔑
catalog.description: Click the Settings icon to configure your preferences and security tokens.

catalog.title: Settings Navigation 🎛️
catalog.description: Jump to specific settings using the navigation bar.

catalog.title: Visual Preferences 🎨
catalog.description: Toggle between Light and Premium Dark modes.

catalog.title: Application Credentials 🗝️
catalog.description: Configure secure credentials for integrations. AI agents use these credentials to perform automated operations.

catalog.title: Enable GitHub Integration 🔌
catalog.description: Click to enable the GitHub integration if you have a personal access token. Don't worry if you don't have a personal access token, this can be configured later.

catalog.title: Personal Access Token 🔑
catalog.description: Input your GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) here so agents can access your repositories. These tokens are stored securely per-user, encrypted at rest, and masked in the UI.

catalog.title: Validate Connection 🔌
catalog.description: Click 'Validate Link' to test your credentials. Note: valid credentials are recommended to complete the full onboarding workflow.

catalog.title: Save Credentials 💾
catalog.description: Save credentials to store this token securely under your profile.

catalog.title: Go Back to Projects list 📂
catalog.description: Click Projects to go back to the catalog list page

catalog.title: Create a Project 🏗️
catalog.description: Now let's launch a new project. Click 'Create Project'

catalog.title: General Configuration 📝
catalog.description: First, give your project a unique name and detailed description.

catalog.title: Select Repository 📂
catalog.description: Select the specific GitHub repository this project is bound to.

catalog.title: Switch to List View 📋
catalog.description: Try switching to the List View to see a more compact representation of your projects.

catalog.title: Toggle Shared Projects 📂
catalog.description: Click on 'Shared Projects' tab to see projects shared by other members in the database.

catalog.title: Begin Onboarding! 🚀
catalog.description: Click 'Onboard' on your newly created project card to launch the workspace and start collaborating with AI agents!

workspace.title: Multi-Phase Workflow Gates 🏁
workspace.description: APF guides projects through 5 sequential gates: Onboarding, Analysis, Planning, Solutioning, and Implementation. Satisfying phase criteria unlocks subsequent gates, with progress tracked by live status bubbles.

workspace.title: Orchestration Control Panel 🎛️
workspace.description: This collapsible sidebar organizes your workspace history, actions and artifacts.

workspace.title: Chat Section 💬
workspace.description: This is where you can see your current and previous conversations

workspace.title: Quick Actions ⚡
workspace.description: Run workflows using these quick action buttons

workspace.title: File Explorer & Phase Artifacts 📁
workspace.description: Navigate artifacts generated for the active phase with live status indicators, or toggle 'Show All' to browse the complete project filesystem.

workspace.title: Autonomous Agent Workspace 💬
workspace.description: Engage your agent! Type instructions, switch agent personas, observe live thinking steps, and watch as the agent runs background commands or edits documents.

workspace.title: Context Integration (File Upload) 📎
workspace.description: Upload local specifications, designs, or code files to provide rich context to your agent. Supported formats include text, PDF, and images (Max 10MB).

workspace.title: Live Document & Design Canvas 🎨
workspace.description: View the output in real-time! Explore generated markdown specifications, directly modify files, inspect code changes via diff previews, or complete reviews.
